_source: rsprox 231/00711, 231/00712, 227/00073, 227/01843, 227/01862 (the crate's interface, its varbits, deposits, withdrawals and the bench) and the Wiki (Fossil Storage: 510 of each; Fossil cleaning bench and the unidentified fossils: what each size cleans into).
_build: Wiki (Fossil cleaning bench): built from its table parts with 5 planks, 5 nails and a hammer, at 5 Construction, for 100 Construction XP; the cache's varbit fossil_bench shows it built (recorded 0 -> 1).
_max: Wiki: "Only 510 of each type of fossil stack can be stored in the crate".
_fossils: The list's slots 0-29 in order (recorded), each stored in its own varbit fossil_storage_<name minus fossil_>.
_amounts: The side's ops (interface_inv_init: Deposit 1, 5, 10, All, X) and the list's, recorded 1 and All for withdrawals.
_cleaning: Wiki: each unidentified size cleans into one of its five (rare: six) pieces; a large one is either a large or a plant fossil, half and half. Equal chances within a set (the Wiki gives no rates).
_tools: Recorded: the brush or the rock pick, chosen each time (7 and 7 across the recordings), a fossil every 6 ticks, the first the tick after.

tools.message: You clean the fossil with your brush.
You clean the fossil with your rock pick.

_messages: All recorded except full, noRoom and the building lines (mine).

messages.useOnBench: Use your fossil on the bench to clean it.
messages.needKit: You will need a full archaeology kit to clean your finds. Wear leather gloves and boots and have a rock pick, trowel and specimen brush. You can find them in the tool crate.
messages.full: Your fossil storage can't hold any more of those.
messages.noRoom: You don't have enough inventory space.
messages.buildLevel: You need a Construction level of 5 to build the cleaning bench.
messages.buildItems: You need 5 planks, 5 nails and a hammer to build the cleaning bench.
